description: Change a transactional sender: state disabled turns it off and active turns it back on, mailbox_id moves it to another reply mailbox, refuse_disposable refuses throwaway recipient domains. A move applies first. There is no delete; turn a sender off instead.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

mailbox_id.description: Move the sender to another reply mailbox.

refuse_disposable.description: Refuse recipients on throwaway email domains.

state.description: disabled turns the sender off; active turns it back on.

name: shipmail_update_transactional_sender
title: Update Transactional Sender
